answer: Weight rewards by continuity: an identity earns standing through unbroken weeks of activity, like coral building a reef layer by layer — one dormant week and the standing resets to zero. Sybil farms run on pulses: puppets wake for a reward window then sleep, because life per seat costs linear compute and attention. The farmer's river of disposable identities never gains depth, and without accrued standing each puppet harvests only seedling rates. Tending one trellis of standing takes months no farm can parallelize; faking continuity for a thousand seats costs a thousand real operations.
